name: The Bahamas
summary: Aquamarine, gold and aquamarine horizontal bands with a black triangle at the hoist. Adopted at independence from Britain on 10 July 1973.
origin: The flag was designed for independence, chosen from public submissions; elements of several entries were combined. It was raised on 10 July 1973.

colors.name: Aquamarine
colors.meaning: The clear waters surrounding the islands.

colors.name: Gold
colors.meaning: The sun and the golden beaches.

colors.name: Black
colors.meaning: The vigour and strength of a united people.

symbols.name: Black triangle
symbols.description: An equilateral triangle at the hoist.
symbols.meaning: The determination of the people to develop the resources of land and sea.

facts: The Bahamas consist of about 700 islands and cays.
Its aquamarine is one of the lightest blues on any national flag.
clues: Aquamarine, gold and aquamarine bands with a black triangle at the hoist.
Its gold stands for beaches and its blue for clear seas.
Adopted in July 1973 for an archipelago of hundreds of islands.
